reason: User explicitly requested broader attempts after the previous study stopped. This is a new study with fresh seeds and gates, not a reopening of its holdout or a retiming of failed measurements.

variants.method: root Q coefficient 0.2 instead of 0.4; otherwise unchanged 8-root halving
root Q coefficient 0.8 instead of 0.4; otherwise unchanged 8-root halving
evaluate top16 once, prune to4 at first elimination, then ordinary halving; all within64 visits
keep top6; add up to2 tactical-scored actions from outside top6; fill remaining slots from prior ranking; at most8 total; no prior/value bonus
keep top8 plus up to4 tactical extras, computed after root NN only for outside candidates; skip heuristics for pass-only roots
ordinary PUCT at root; final choice uses log(prior)+0.4*(50+max child visits)*Q over viable actions visited at least twice; proofs still override; fallback original visits if no such action

scope: Search-only campaign with frozen network. Keep original production assets until independent strength and PC latency/correctness gates pass. No hosted deployment. Learning changes require a separate recipe before training.

refine.selection: At most one eligible candidate, highest overall score; tie uses registered variant order.

matches.seed: FNV1a32(phaseSeed|board|pair|ply); independently seeded xorshift opening sampler; same opening and per-ply seed for both colours and variants
matches.moveCap: 6*N; retain capped games; no outcome-dependent seed replacement
matches.score: actual Game area score, komi6.5, draw half point

diagnostics.reportedGame: development-only fixture from prior study; no L6-specific rule or requirement that overrides playing-strength selection
diagnostics.previousDevelopmentRoots: may be reused only for development diagnostics; prior sealed holdout stays unused

correctness: full match replay and trace audit
selected candidate actual CPU/WebGPU Worker and numerical parity

latency.fixture: fresh screen-origin roots, first colour1 game in registered board order at N/4,N/2,3N/4; reported and pass/proof stress roots fixed before timing

stress.reason: Predeclared absolute tolerance for very short roots motivated by the previous 1.3ms outlier; applies only to new measurements and does not change the previous study verdict.

latency.condition: quiet environment, alternating order, includes restore/search/normal yields; no diagnostic logging

selectionPolicy: Freeze configuration/binary before each next stage. Max2 screen finalists, max1 independent candidate. No tuning, sample extension, fallback to runner-up on independent failure or repeated holdouts. Failure retains baseline and is reported.
outputs: fresh workspace, full games and compact per-turn diagnostics, command/source/model hashes, archived positive and negative results; no overwrite of previous experiment artifacts
